LinkedIn:
Registration is now open for New Horizons, a five-day UK health tech mission to Boston.

TWEA is leading the mission from 26 to 30 April 2027, with UK Tech Advocates and Tech London Advocates & Global Tech Advocates. It is supported by DSIT, Havas Lynx, Hardian Health, ABHI and shipshape.vc.

The mission is for scaling health tech companies looking at the US. Delegates get:
– pre-mission briefings on US regulation and market access
– meetings with hospitals, payers and research centres
– the chance to pitch to investors
– support after the mission

Places are limited to two delegates per company.

Want to find out more first? Join our free online briefing on 13 November at 3pm UK time, with Chris Born, TWEA's HealthTech Ambassador. Bring your questions.

Book your place at the briefing: [booking link]

#HealthTech #BristolTech #WestOfEngland #TechWestEngland

Final call for UK scale-ups: there is still time to join our tech mission to China's Greater Bay Area.

From 23 to 27 November 2026, delegates will spend a week across Guangzhou, Shenzhen and Hong Kong. The mission is delivered with UK & Global Tech Advocates, the Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade, the University of the West of England, Hewlett Rand and other partners.

Across five days and three cities you can expect:
– access to prospects, supply-chain partners and investors
– visits to tech and innovation parks
– company visits and roundtables
– British consulate receptions

It works. Past delegates from companies including Haylo, Q5D, Kaiku and Quantum Science Ltd have joined before, and delegates have reported finding a manufacturing partner and investor interest.

Entry is £2k + VAT. Applications close [deadline].

If the Greater Bay Area is on your growth plan, apply now: [link]

#BristolTech #WestOfEngland #TechWestEngland #TradeMission

LinkedIn:
We were proud to represent the West of England at the Global Tech Advocates Summit in Istanbul.

Hosted by Tech Türkiye Advocates, the summit brought together the Global Tech Advocates network. Our founder, Richard Lowe, shared TWEA's plans for more events and initiatives to support tech scale-ups across the West Midlands, the West of England and the South West.

We came home with two clear priorities:

1. Stronger support for regional and UK scale-ups.
2. Connecting more capital to ambitious founders, especially at Series A and beyond, through the newly launched GTA Innovation Funding Working Group.

Thank you to Tech Türkiye Advocates for hosting, and to Tech London Advocates & Global Tech Advocates for bringing the network together. [Add any other thanks or highlights]

Are you a founder raising at Series A or beyond? We would like to hear what support would help you most. Tell us in the comments.

#BristolTech #WestOfEngland #TechWestEngland #ScaleUp

TWEA Base camp is hosting a Christmas party, and you're invited.

The Future Space Christmas Party takes place on [date] at [venue], from [time].

It's a chance to close out the year with people building tech across the West of England, the South West and the West Midlands. Meet fellow founders, catch up with the wider TWEA community and enjoy an evening together before the new year.

TWEA is a not-for-profit, volunteer-led community supporting tech founders and scale-ups across the region. We connect them with partners, investors and international markets, and events like this help bring that community together.

If you're new to TWEA, this is a friendly place to start.
